decision.reason: The official 3B repository has no GGUF artifact for the M3MBA-007 TL1/TL2 BitNet.cpp command shape, and downloading the safetensors shards would leave the Mac below the hard free-space floor.
next_unblockers: An official TL1/TL2 GGUF appears in 1bitLLM/bitnet_b1_58-3B.
A reproducible conversion path from the official safetensors repository to a runner-supported TL1/TL2 GGUF is approved.
A separate artifact-authority item explicitly approves a third-party TL diagnostic artifact with source, revision, SHA256, tokenizer authority, runner command, output, and cleanup evidence.
Local storage is freed enough that any approved large-candidate download leaves at least the hard free-space floor after download.

claim_boundary: No TL1 or TL2 diagnostic inference was run.
